thread_text:
Oliver Grant: Morning all - Oliver here, first day on Eng-Platform. Laptop delivered but I can't enroll in MDM. Who do I ping for SSH/org access? Icebreaker: two truths and a lie: 1) I've run a food truck for a summer, 2) I can knit a sweater, 3) I once did a small cameo in a documentary. Which is the lie?

Marta (IT): Hi Oliver, Marta from IT. Send the device serial or DM me and I'll resend the Jamf invite. Also confirm mac or windows.

Oliver Grant: MacBook Pro - serial C02MGR12345. Jamf invite not in spam.

Marta (IT): Resent invite and manually approved. You should see the enrollment prompt in ~3 minutes.

Zoe - eng-platform: Welcome Oliver! I'm your buddy. For SSH: generate an ed25519 key and paste the public key into the access form or DM me and I'll add you to the team org. Example: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "oliver.grant@redwood.com"`

Oliver Grant: Thanks Zoe — just submitted the pub key and enrolled the device. Also guessing the lie is the food truck one.

HR Bot: Reminder - complete benefits enrollment and payroll setup within 48 hours: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding

Zoe - eng-platform: Close! The food truck was true, knitting is the lie. Welcome aboard, see you in #eng-platform.

Oliver Grant: Haha nice — I did run a small taco truck in SF for three months. Thanks for the help everyone, excited to get started!
